Title: Suresh's Day

Cast

1. Suresh - 29 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Shalini - 55 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Rajesh - 62 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
4. Meenakshi - 27 years, friend
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
5. Sanjay - 36 years, friend
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Suresh stands on the road. Shalini and Rajesh stand near him.]

Shalini: "Suresh, what's the plan today?"

[Suresh starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Suresh: "I'm ready!"

[Suresh's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Rajesh: "Really?"

[Suresh is killed when a truck hits him.]

Rajesh: "We will never forget you."
